about.dataset: DOHMH New York City Restaurant Inspection Results
about.publisher: New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH), via NYC Open Data
about.target: at least 2 critical violations at an initial cycle inspection

threshold.rule: the calibrated-probability cut-off that flags the stated capacity per week on average over the validation weeks, applied unchanged to the test weeks

matched_history.rule: rows whose previous initial inspection took place at most 365 days earlier
